text:
ashley: Heads up — after last night's NVIDIA driver bump (536.12) our autotuner is switching to the tiled-attn kernel for mid-length sequences (256-512) on H100 canaries. KV-cache per-token latency up ~18% in the canary fleet. Perf CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345

ben: same here. saw spikes in tail p99 for the rerank routes. profiler shows a shift to shared-mem tiled kernel at layer 10..18. attaching quick sample:
```
Profiler: kernel_pick: tiled_attn_shared_mem (est_warps=24)
old_pick: linear_attn (est_warps=16)
KV latency sample: 3.8ms -> 4.5ms
```

diego: which heuristic fired? Is this the seqlen threshold or the occupancy tie-breaker?

ben: looks like the occupancy tie-breaker. The driver exposes slightly different SM scheduling numbers so estimated warp occupancy calc increased ~1.3x, and the tie-break flips to tiled for more cases.

ryan: mitigation options: 1) revert driver on canaries 2) force kernel override for affected models/routes 3) tune tie-break thresholds and ship a config hotfix. Revert is fastest to stop user impact.

ashley: agree revert canaries immediately, then do a staggered plan for dedicated pools. Can someone run the canary rollback? ops-bot can queue it.

ops-bot: @channel rollback job queued: rollback-driver-canary (job id: rb-20260317-7). ETA 8m. :gear:

ben: I'll open a patch to the autotuner: log the tie-break decision and add a unit to simulate small shifts in occupancy calc. Also adding a per-model override flag so we can flip kernel without code deploy.

ashley: good. after canary rollback, collect before/after perf diffs and KV cache hit/miss timings. tag the traces with `kernel_choice_reason`.

diego: for the short term we should add a runtime override snippet (hot-config):
```
runtime.override_kernels = [
  {"model": "gpt-small-prod", "force": "kv_friendly_attn"},
  {"route_prefix": "/rerank", "force": "linear_attn"}
]
```

ryan: commands I'll run if rollback has issues:
```
helm rollback nv-driver 42 --namespace infra-drivers
kubectl rollout restart -n runtime svc/llm-serving-canary
```

ashley: assign owners:
- canary rollback: @ryan (run and monitor)
- autotuner logging + unit: @ben
- hot-config override PR: @diego
- postmortem + perf dashboards: @ashley

ben: will also add an alert for "kernel-choice-rate-change" so we detect future flips.

ryan: rollback started. watching metrics now. will post p50/p99 in ~10m.

ops-bot: rollback-driver-canary job started (rb-20260317-7).

ashley: thanks — keep updates in this thread. we'll decide on full fleet plan after canary results. :thumbsup:
